name: Engraving
author: E. T. Carter
description: A copperplate line engraving of undulating drapery, ink on laid paper. Parallel burin lines wrap over every fold like cross-contours, swelling from hairlines that taper into bare paper on the lit crests to fat cuts in the shadow; a second family crosses them in the half-shadow and a third in the deepest hollows, with a dot in every lozenge of the half-tones. The drapery breathes slowly and the raking light precesses, so the hatch migrates across the folds.

params.label: Line pitch
params.effect: CSS-pixel spacing of the engraved lines; low is a fine dense plate, high is a coarse open ruling.

params.label: Wrap
params.effect: How far the lines bend around the folds; 0 is a flat straight ruling shaded only by weight, high is strongly contoured.

params.label: Relief
params.effect: Depth of the drapery and its tonal range; low is a shallow pale plate, high drives deep cross-hatched shadows.

params.label: Ink
params.effect: Ink density of the impression; low is a pale worn-plate pull, 1 is a fresh dense print.

params.label: Breathe
params.effect: How fast the drapery breathes and the light precesses; 0 holds the plate still.
